title: Fill in Reflexive Pronouns in Sentences

instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the correct reflexive pronoun.

atoms.a: ssml: My mum cut <break time='500ms'/> while she was cooking.
atoms.b: My mum cut ((++herself himself)) while she was cooking.
atoms.finishSound: My mum cut herself while she was cooking.

atoms.a: ssml: The TV turns <break time='500ms'/> off after a while.
atoms.b: The TV turns ((++itself ourselves)) off after a while.
atoms.finishSound: The TV turns itself off after a while.

atoms.a: ssml: I can’t help you Mason. You have to do it by <break time='500ms'/>.
atoms.b: I can’t help you, Mason. You have to do it by ((++yourself themselves)).
atoms.finishSound: I can’t help you, Mason. You have to do it by yourself.

atoms.a: ssml: You can all help <break time='500ms'/> to the drinks.
atoms.b: You can all help ((++yourselves herself)) to the drinks.
atoms.finishSound: You can all help yourselves to the drinks.
